purpose: Master-inventory revision r6 for the active regions (Rímac/Carretera Central, Pisco/Ica, Santa/Casma): rows named in ANA DU 015-2023 Anexo II/III that the master inventory did not carry, plus a link row for Quebrada Huarangal (Pisco) to the unit main already registers.
